item.title: All matches announced for WWE WrestleMania 42 so far ft. Brock Lesnar, CM Punk, Roman Reigns, Rhea Ripley & more
item.description: WrestleMania 42 is approaching fast and WWE has started the build up for the two-night spectacle. Here are the announced matches for the show.

item.title: Will Sanju Samson play tonight for IND vs WI in T20 World Cup 2026 Super 8 clash?
item.description: With the place in the semifinal of the ICC T20 World Cup 2026 on the line, Sanju Samson's place in XI for IND vs WI remains in news.

item.title: Where will semi-finals of T20 World Cup 2026 take place?
item.description: The semi-finals of the ICC T20 World Cup 2026 will be held on March 4 and 5, with the finals on March 8. Let's see where will semi-finals take place

item.title: Can Lalrinzuala Lalbiaknia fill Sunil Chhetri's boot?
item.description: Lalrinzuala Lalbiaknia’s rise fuels hope for India’s next striker, with many seeing him as a potential successor to Sunil Chhetri’s legacy in attack.

item.title: ISL 2025-26: Odisha FC coach Purushothaman and Amrinder Singh speak ahead of Chennaiyin FC clash
item.description: Addressing the media, Purushothaman and Amrinder Singh expressed confidence in the squad’s preparation, stressing discipline, focus and belief ahead of the Chennaiyin FC clash.

item.title: Will Sri Lanka host any more T20 World Cup 2026 matches?
item.description: Both Sri Lanka and Pakistan have been knocked out of the T20 World Cup 2026. Let's take a look if more matches will take place in Sri Lanka.

item.title: ISL 2025-26: Clifford Miranda confident of turnaround against Odisha FC
item.description: Addressing the media, Clifford Miranda voiced confidence in a turnaround against Odisha FC, while Farukh Choudhary backed the team’s belief and readiness.

item.title: Has Babar Azam played his last T20I for Pakistan?
item.description: Dropped for the decisive clash against Sri Lanka and struggling for impact, Babar Azam’s position in T20I faces uncertainty.

item.title: IND vs WI Dream11 Prediction, मैच 52 सुपर 8, टी20 वर्ल्ड कप 2026
item.description: IND vs WI के टी20 वर्ल्ड कप 2026 मैच में इन धाकड़ खिलाड़ियों को अपनी फैंटसी टीम में शामिल करके आप Dream11 में बड़ा ईनाम जीत सकते हैं।

item.title: टी20 वर्ल्ड कप 2026 पॉइंट्स टेबल, सबसे ज्यादा रन और विकेट, सुपर 8 मैच 50 के बाद, SL vs PAK
item.description: आइए देखतें हैं कि टी20 वर्ल्ड कप 2026 के 50वें मैच के बाद पॉइंट्स टेबल, सबसे ज्यादा रन और विकेट की लिस्ट में क्या-क्या बदलाव हुए हैं।
